basis: T1 accepted D106; current regular B0 with explicit edge controls; no C1/C2 overlay
renderer: Skiko source-backed Glass Quality; per-instance T1 collaborator; tagged sRGB SDR
material: GlassStyle.regular actual built-in with transparent background; geometry and optical/tone settings unchanged across modes and backgrounds

backdrops.split: gray 0.1 for x<64 and 0.9 for x>=64
backdrops.photo: repository photo.jpg; scaled 256x170 and cropped; path and SHA below

photo.repository_provenance: git d7c51af836477340f6e30a1911d80e9c142b28a9; original photo attribution/licence not located; repository LICENSE applies to repository generally, individual asset licence unverified

motion.source_translation_px: frame n: min(n,89), moves 1px/frame for 0..89; stationary frames 90..119 at 89px
motion.surface_only_move: separate control uses stationary source and surface translation 8px
motion.capture_format: lossless PNG frame-%04d.png, presentation timestamps n/60 seconds
motion.video: H.264, yuv420p, 60 simulated fps, no audio

output_gating: HAZE_T2_ARTIFACT_DIR enables writes only; rendering and assertions always run
expected: at least 20 separate still test cases and 3 independent motion sequences; no skips
